facts.fact: 她的定性：那不是疼，是彻底而荣耀的投降。
facts.anchor: It wasn't pain. It was an absolute, glorious surrender.

facts.fact: 她改口承认：他也许几乎和我一样聪明——策略层面。
facts.anchor: He might even be almost as smart as me.

facts.fact: 她的所有权宣言：无论他的力量多可怕，他属于我。
facts.anchor: no matter how terrifying his strength was to the rest of the world, he belonged to me.

facts.fact: 她的成长定义：另一种陷阱。
facts.anchor: My entire life had been defined by a different kind of trap.

facts.fact: 她过去的孤独：即使在人群里也彻底孤身。
facts.anchor: Even in a room full of people, I had always been completely alone in the crowd

facts.fact: Blackwood 家的不同：他们不想藏起她或修好她。
facts.anchor: They didn't want to hide me or fix me. They accepted me.

facts.fact: 核心：他让她觉得自己被选中。
facts.anchor: And Gunnar... Gunnar made me feel chosen.

facts.fact: 她的自嘲：当他的妻子是最好的伪装。
facts.anchor: It was the best disguise ever.

facts.fact: 章末：她第一次说出这三个字（耳语）。
